name: 超速再生·造成伤害
description: 乌尔奇奥拉造成伤害后恢复生命并累计归刃进度。
skillCode: var piece = context.rulePiece; if (!piece || !context.sourcePiece || context.sourcePiece.instanceId !== piece.instanceId || !(context.damage > 0)) return { success: false, message: '' }; var transformed = piece.statusTags && piece.statusTags.some(function(tag) { return tag.id === 'ulquiorra-resurreccion-' + piece.instanceId; }); if (!transformed) { var progress = piece.statusTags && piece.statusTags.find(function(tag) { return tag.type === 'ulquiorra-resurreccion-progress'; }); if (!progress) { progress = { id: 'ulquiorra-resurreccion-progress-' + piece.instanceId, type: 'ulquiorra-resurreccion-progress', name: '归刃进度', visible: true, currentDuration: -1, currentUses: -1, intensity: 0, stacks: 0 }; piece.statusTags.push(progress); } progress.intensity = Math.min(3, (progress.intensity || 0) + 1); progress.stacks = progress.intensity; } if (piece.currentHp > 0) context.healQueue.push({ healer: piece, target: piece, heal: 2, skillId: 'ulquiorra-high-speed-regeneration' }); return { success: true, message: piece.name + '触发超速再生' };
